Add ParseServer(flagValue, envValue) -> {URL, Source("--server"|"AF_URL"), FromFlag}: --server wins, empty AF_URL is unset, absolute http/https with host, optional path prefix, one trailing '/' dropped, query/fragment/userinfo refused; error messages name the source and rule and never echo userinfo; Insecure() true for http with non-loopback host (localhost, 127.0.0.0/8, ::1 via net.ParseIP().IsLoopback())

In cmd/af add client_common.go: shared helper that resolves server (flag --server + AF_URL), raises server_insecure, loads the credential in the R4 order (after server), raises credential_file_permissions, and maps afclient errors to toolio.Failure with R3 categories and the fix_hint

Define a Go result type for it and its result schema; keep the schema golden update for the final docs/schema task

tasks.title: Request bounds, redirect refusal, answer mapping, messages, hints and verbatim documents
steps: Write TS-16-28 and TS-16-38..TS-16-44 against a scripted fake service (injectable clock/timeouts) and confirm they fail

In internal/afclient implement the full answer mapping table of 16-REQ-6.5: 400/404 usage (not retryable), 401 and 422 auth, 409 conflict, 502 hub retryable, 500 service, 503/504/other 5xx service retryable, 3xx and other 4xx (405/413/415/418) service not retryable, transport error or 2-minute bound service retryable, oversize/non-JSON body service not retryable; return a typed *Error{Status, Code, Message, Category, Retryable, Hint}

Bound each non-stream request by min(2 minutes, command's remaining --timeout) using context with an injectable clock/deadline; read at most 8 MiB (io.LimitReader+1 to detect overflow); never follow redirects and never send anything to a 3xx target

Build messages: service error.message followed by (error.code), or `the service answered <status>`; transport errors name the server URL and its source (--server or AF_URL); a 404 names the job id or workspace slug and says it does not exist or hub does not let the caller see it

Attach fix hints: 401 {suggest "af login --token-file FILE"}; 404 on a workspace route and 409 not_subscribed/token_unreadable {suggest "af workspace subscribe <slug> --hub-token-file FILE"} with the real slug; 422 {flag "--hub-token-file"}
Return service JSON documents as json.RawMessage so unknown fields survive; read only needed fields via small decode structs
Make cmd/af/client_common.go map *afclient.Error to toolio.Failure (status usage for category usage); confirm exit codes 2/1 follow
Ensure no default --timeout on any client command (DefaultTimeout 0) and a --timeout expiry gives the shell's timeout failure

tasks.title: Event-stream follower with tries, backoff and `af jobs watch`
steps: Write TS-16-61..TS-16-68 against a scripted SSE fake service with an injected clock (sleep recorder) and a rapid/property-style generator for cuts and duplicate frames; confirm they fail

In internal/afclient add an SSE reader over bufio.Reader (buffer for lines up to 1 MiB): frames by id:/event:/data: lines and blank line, CRLF or LF, ignore comment lines and unknown fields, 60 s idle cut using an injectable timer; Accept text/event-stream; no 2-minute bound on the stream

Add Follow(ctx, id, since, hooks) implementing tries: events request with since=last seq, then on stream end one GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}; at rest = state blocked/done/failed/cancelled and no attempt running; drop events with seq <= last delivered; call OnEvent for each delivered event with the raw event document

Failed-try accounting: a try ending not at rest with no new event is failed (EOF, drop, idle cut, unreadable frame, 5xx or transport error on events or on job read); a delivering try resets the count; delay before next try 1 s after a delivering try and 1,2,4,8 s after failed tries 1-4; the fifth consecutive failure returns a typed give-up error with the last failure's category (hub for 502, else service), retryable true, and the last seq, with no wait after it
A 401, 404, 3xx or other 4xx on either request returns the R6 mapped error at once with no further try

Add cmd/af/jobs.go with `af jobs watch <id> [--since N]`: record the job artifact before following, emit each delivered event as the af event job_event (data = the event document) via Run.Emit, write each event document as one compact JSON line to Run.Stderr, give-up failure gets next `af jobs watch <id> --since <last>` (+ `--server <url>` when from the flag)
Result building (envelope fetch and status mapping) is the next task; here at-rest returns the job document as result {job, envelope:null} with status done so the command is functional
Keep Follow free of toolio imports; inject clock via a Clock interface field
done_when: the property test shows every event once in ascending order for arbitrary cuts and duplicates
